acceptance.given: Package A subprocess capability changes are implemented within the existing subprocess execution ownership boundaries, with the repository's established Runner, job envelope, process-tree cancellation owner, and timeout engine available for reuse.

oracle.expected: A static architecture check over the Package A implementation and its targeted tests finds no second Runner, job envelope, process-tree controller, or timeout-engine instance or implementation; subprocess capability code delegates to the existing owners.
forbidden: A new Runner is created in Package A.
A new job envelope is created in Package A.
A new process-tree controller is created in Package A.
A new timeout engine is created in Package A.
oracle.observable: The Package A source and targeted architecture test output identify only the pre-existing subprocess ownership implementations and contain no additional implementation or instantiation of those four components.

acceptance.then: The Package A architecture remains within the existing subprocess execution ownership boundaries and contains no additional Runner, job envelope, process-tree controller, or timeout engine.
acceptance.when: During validation of the Package A implementation, run the repository's static architecture/ownership checks and targeted tests against the Package A subprocess capability source; evaluate the artifact and test output for duplicate component implementations or instances.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the Package A architecture/ownership validation that detects a newly introduced Runner, job envelope, process-tree controller, or timeout engine implementation or instance.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Keep Package A subprocess capabilities delegated to the existing Runner, job-envelope, process-tree cancellation, and timeout ownership; reject duplicate implementations or instances.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema changes; reverting the Package A ownership check preserves the existing subprocess execution contract.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package A validation transitions from an implementation that may introduce duplicate execution owners to one that reuses the established owners and reports a failure when a duplicate is detected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted architecture/ownership validation exits successfully only when Package A contains no additional Runner, job envelope, process-tree controller, or timeout-engine implementation or instance.
